svg.text: Audio Chains — 48 kHz main bus, explicit boundaries
RX · USB or network source → clients
FT-710/Yaesu USB 44.1 kHz → 882→960 · Icom USB 48 kHz · G7250 LAN 16 kHz → soxr
SCU-LAN10 header rate + MAIN=L/SUB=R · SunSDR IQ demod · Flex 24 kHz float stereo → filtered 48 kHz mono
48 kHz / 20 ms main bus → native recording/FT8/local taps → rx_db listener copy → Opus48 or PCM48
Wall-clock pacing · bounded network queues · stale backlog dropped · AudioWorklet jitter buffer
RECORDING / FT8 / LOCAL · native truth before listener gain
RecordingSession (AD-017): monotonic RX/TX timeline → 96-tap FIR 48k→16k → incremental MP3 + index
16 kHz is storage only · FT8 gets unmodified capture and re-anchors after capture gaps · local speaker has bounded ALSA queue
One writer per recording session · free-space refusal · no automatic recording deletion
TX · operator mic / CQ / FT8 → supported backend
Mic 48 kHz → /WSaudioTX or terminal 0x01 → _feed_tx_uplink_frame owner gate → decode → tx_mic_db → TX recording
USB rate conversion + dedicated output executor · SunSDR SSB modulation · Flex 24 kHz Opus/VITA pacer
60 ms prebuffer · 400 ms cap · queue_drops/non_owner_drops visible · release always accepted
CQ (AD-020) and FT8 enter after mic gain · finite/abortable automated TX · SCU-LAN10 TX refused
No silent-carrier fallback: unknown TX audio protocol means no key-up
Blocking PortAudio/D-Bus work off-loop · native rebuild closes streams under lifecycle lock · terminal media congestion drops frames, not PTT control
